title: SEC2: Remove redundant sanitize_display call in draw_chat_list hot path
description:
File: ui.rs:77 (draw_chat_list inner map closure)
Issue: sanitize_display() is called on every chat name on every 50ms redraw (20 FPS). Chat names are already sanitized at storage time in load_startup_data() (event.rs lines ~177, ~226). This is a double-sanitization — O(N) byte scan + String allocation per chat name per frame.
Fix: Remove the sanitize_display() call from draw_chat_list. Change:
  ListItem::new(Span::raw(crate::app::sanitize_display(name.as_str()))).style(style)
to:
  ListItem::new(Span::raw(name.as_str())).style(style)
Data stored in state.chat_list is already sanitized at write time.
